widgets_values:
Reference: image 1 = character identity (pale platinum-blonde shaggy bob, blue eyes, fair skin, sharp features — keep face and hair 100% consistent), image 2 = outfit (black lace-up denim corset romper, black leather belt with silver buckle, black fishnet thigh-high garter stockings, black chunky platform lace-up boots), image 3 = location (dark cyberpunk penthouse loft — floor-to-ceiling windows with night city skyline, red LED ceiling light strips, glass-topped pool table, sectional couch, low black coffee table, media wall with fireplace/screen)

Shot: single continuous handheld tracking shot, camera following the character from behind and slightly to the side at hip height. She starts standing at the floor-to-ceiling window with the city skyline behind her, glances out briefly, then turns and walks across the loft toward the fireplace/media wall. Camera glides alongside her in a smooth lateral tracking move, keeping her centered as she passes the pool table and sectional couch, ending on a medium shot of her stopping in front of the fireplace, red ceiling light catching the studs on her belt and the sheen of her boots.

Style: moody cyberpunk interior, cool blue ambient light mixed with warm red accent glow, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field with soft bokeh on background city lights, cinematic anamorphic feel, slow deliberate pacing.

Audio: soft footsteps on concrete/glass flooring, faint ambient city hum through the windows, low atmospheric interior tone, no music, no dialogue.

Do not include: extra people, text, subtitles, watermark, logos, changes to her face or outfit, camera cuts or jump cuts (must stay one continuous take).
